novelty_basis: Termination follows from the right-barren criterion (OVL(r,l) = {a, aa} with r_alpha in {baba, bab}; OVL(l,r) = {b}, l_beta = aa, never a suffix) - a rediscovery; the exact per-word formula and the complexity were not found in McNaughton's or Geser's reports (searches 2026-10-18). Small.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C20.md Theorem 2 - a pair of a's travels to the last run in d steps, doubling d; random descent); per-word formula and D(n) verified on all words of length <= 12 (EXP-C20-01); awaiting independent skeptic review
statement:
The one-rule system aab -> babaa (and its symmetric images) terminates. For w = a^(x_0) b a^(x_1) b ... b a^(x_m),
every maximal derivation has length sum_{k=m-1..0} d_k (2^floor(x_k/2) - 1) with d_k = (m - k) + (steps
contributed by the runs right of k); the derivational complexity is D(n) = max_{1<=b<=n} b(2^floor((n-b)/2) - 1),
attained by a^(n-b) b^b.
title: aab -> babaa terminates; exact per-word derivation length and D(n) = max_b b(2^floor((n-b)/2) - 1)
